subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased and made maintainer-modifiable, or replace it with a maintainer-owned narrow fix?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate is outside the target repository, currently conflicting, and not maintainer-modifiable.

options.title: Replace the uneditable PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow replacement PR in this repository, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

options.title: Ask for contributor rebase
options.body: Keep the issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it onto current main with maintainer-modifiable settings if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open until the contributor updates the branch, accepting that the source-reproducible bug remains unresolved meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Replace the uneditable PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow replacement PR in this repository, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original shared sanitizer and authored the TUI leading-only stripping path, making them the strongest routing candidate for this UI/TUI boundary choice.
